description: Creates an incoming webhook: a URL a third-party service POSTs JSON to; Neblla passes the body to a live room's server file (neblla.room.on("hook")), to the user named in the call if online, or to the app's inbox as a notice. Returns the URL, shown only now. The same name again gives a new URL and the old one stops. Up to 20 per app. Waits in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save". More: neblla_get_llms tools/create_hook

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name.description: A letter, then letters, digits, _ or - (up to 40).

room.description: The room's code, when to is "room".

to.description: room: a live room's server file; user: the user in ?user=<id>, if online; inbox: a notice (needs the inbox module).

name: neblla_create_hook
title: Create an incoming webhook
